style: Flat layered landscape illustration of the Kansas Flint Hills: treeless, gently rolling tallgrass hills drawn as flat stacked layers under a big open sky. Soft gradients and subtle film grain. Minimal, cozy and calm. No outlines, no text. Warm, muted earth tones: tallgrass gold, sage, rust, dusty blue sky. Wide 16:9 composition with the horizon at half height. The left 60% of the frame is simple, quiet and low-contrast; all visual interest sits in the right third.
holiday_keep: Keep every holiday decoration already in the picture exactly as it is, in the same place, at the same small size and in the same colors; do not add, move or remove any.
keep: Keep the exact same composition, horizon line, hill shapes, layers, framing and illustration style. Keep the left 60% of the image simple and low-contrast. Do not add text.

base.prompt: Only hills and sky: no buildings, no trees, no people, no animals, no structures. A gentle ridge in the right third of the image, just below the horizon, at about 80% across.
base.negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, outlines, line art, ink, trees, buildings, house, windmill, people, animals, fence, road, photorealistic, photograph, busy detail, high contrast, frame, border

windmill.foot: the foot of the windmill's tower
windmill.lights_on: the windmill itself: wrapped tightly around the four legs of its lattice tower, spiraling up to the fan wheel
windmill.add: Add a tiny, distant old-fashioned American farm water-pumping windmill standing alone on the crest of the far ridge, at about 80% across the image, its feet resting on the top of the ridge line just below the horizon, far away from the viewer. It has a narrow four-legged steel lattice tower that tapers toward the top, and on top a round fan wheel of many short metal blades with a flat tail vane behind it. It is a classic Kansas ranch windmill, not a Dutch windmill and not a modern wind turbine. Draw it as simple flat shapes in a muted weathered grey, in the same flat style as the hills, with no outlines. It is very small in the frame: about a tenth of the image height and much narrower than a tenth of the image width. Nothing else is added.

holiday_prompts.christmas: Add exactly one small evergreen tree on the crest of the ridge, standing in the yard close beside the right side of the farmhouse. It is a single tree, the only tree in the whole image: there is no tree on the left side of the farmhouse. It is small, no taller than the bottom edge of the farmhouse's roof: a simple flat dark green cone shape in the same flat style, decorated with tiny warm glowing Christmas lights, small bright dots of red, green, gold and blue. Do not redraw or change the farmhouse at all: keep its exact shape, size, roof, walls, windows, chimney and colors. No lights anywhere else: not on the house, along the ridge, on the ground or in the sky. Nothing else changes: do not add snow, a wreath, white streaks or anything else on the hills.
holiday_prompts.halloween: Add a single small glowing jack-o'-lantern sitting in the grass on the crest of the ridge, just to the left of the farmhouse. Do not redraw or change the farmhouse at all: keep its exact shape, size, roof, walls, windows, chimney and colors; do not add a porch, steps, a door or lit windows. Nothing else is added; keep it small.

farmhouse.add: Add a tiny, distant old Kansas prairie farmhouse standing alone on the crest of the far ridge, at about 80% across the image, its base resting on the top of the ridge line just below the horizon, far away from the viewer. It is a simple two-story white clapboard house with a steep gabled roof in a muted weathered red and a single small brick chimney. Draw it as simple flat shapes in the same flat style as the hills, with no outlines and no fine detail. It is very small in the frame: about a tenth of the image height and no wider than a tenth of the image width. No barn, no fence, no road, no trees. Nothing else is added.

lone_tree.hang_on: a low branch of the lone tree
lone_tree.foot: the foot of the lone tree's trunk
lone_tree.lights_on: the lone tree itself: wrapped loosely around the branches of its canopy
lone_tree.add: Add a single tiny, distant lone tree standing alone on the crest of the far ridge, at about 80% across the image, its trunk resting on the top of the ridge line just below the horizon, far away from the viewer. It is an old, wind-shaped prairie bur oak with a short sturdy trunk and a broad, rounded, slightly lopsided canopy. Draw it as simple flat shapes in a muted deep olive green with a darker trunk, in the same flat style as the hills, with no outlines and no individual leaves. It is very small in the frame: about a tenth of the image height and no wider than a tenth of the image width. It is the only tree in the whole image. Nothing else is added.

seasons.spring: Make it spring: the hills turn fresh, soft green with new tallgrass. Recolor one band of the existing far ridge on the right, below the {noun}, as recently burned prairie greening up: a flat, muted charcoal-brown band softly tinted with green. Do not add any new hills or slopes and do not change any hill shapes; no individual grass blades or sprouts, just flat color.
seasons.summer: Make it high summer: the hills are lush deep green and sage, with warm sunlight and a clear dusty blue sky.
seasons.autumn: Make it autumn: the tallgrass turns gold, rust and copper, under a soft warm sky.
seasons.winter: Make it winter: the tallgrass is dormant, pale straw and muted tan with cool grey-blue shadows, under a pale, cold sky. No snow.

hill_colors.spring: fresh soft green, with the flat charcoal-brown burned band on the far ridge
hill_colors.winter: pale straw and muted tan with cool grey-blue shadows

times.night: Make it night: a dark deep-blue sky with a bright moon and a few soft stars, the hills lit by cool moonlight in darker muted tones. The {noun} becomes a dark silhouette against the sky.

time_keep.night: It is night: ignore the daytime sky colors above. Keep the sky a dark deep navy blue with the moon, keep the whole scene dark and moonlit, and do not brighten it toward dusk or day. The {noun} stays a dark silhouette.

conditions.clear: Make the sky completely clear and cloudless, keeping the same sky colors.
conditions.partlycloudy: Add a few soft, flat clouds drifting in the sky, leaving plenty of open sky.
conditions.cloudy: Make the sky fully overcast with soft, flat layered grey clouds.
conditions.fog: Add soft fog: low mist lying in the valleys between the hills, the far layers fading into haze.
conditions.rainy: Make it a light rain: soft grey clouds and thin, gentle streaks of falling rain.
conditions.pouring: Make it pouring rain: heavy dark storm clouds and dense sheets of falling rain.
conditions.lightning-rainy: Make it a thunderstorm: dark storm clouds and falling rain, with one bright lightning bolt in the sky in the right third.
conditions.snowy: Make it snowing: small, soft snowflakes falling evenly across the whole sky, and an even, thin dusting of snow over all the hills. No bright streaks, smears or patches of white.
conditions.windy: Make it windy: the tallgrass bends and sways to one side, with streaky, wind-swept clouds racing across the sky.

holiday_conditions.lightning-rainy: Make it a thunderstorm: dark storm clouds only along the very top edge of the sky, falling rain, and one bright lightning bolt in the right third that does not cover anything. Every holiday decoration in the sky stays clearly visible, bright and in front of the clouds and rain.

valentines.prompt: Hang a small red heart on {hang_on}, and add a few tiny soft pink hearts floating in the sky just above the {noun}. Nothing else is added; keep it all small and only in the right third.

st_patricks.prompt: Hang a small green shamrock garland on {hang_on}, with a few small shamrocks (three-leaf clovers) on the crest of the ridge at {foot}. Nothing else is added; keep it all small and only in the right third.

easter.prompt: Add a small white rabbit sitting on the crest of the ridge beside {foot}, with a few small pastel-colored Easter eggs in the grass next to it. Nothing else is added; keep it all small and only in the right third.

july_4th.prompt: Add a few small red, white and blue fireworks bursting in the sky in the right third, above the {noun}. Keep them small and only in the right third.

halloween.prompt: Add a single small glowing jack-o'-lantern sitting on the crest of the ridge right at {foot}. Nothing else is added; keep it small.

thanksgiving.prompt: Add one small round hay bale and a few small pumpkins sitting on the crest of the ridge right at {foot}. Nothing is added anywhere else; the left side of the image stays empty.

christmas.prompt: Decorate the {noun} with one short strand of small, warm, glowing Christmas lights on {lights_on}. The lights are tiny bright dots of red, green, gold and blue, in the same flat style. The lights touch only the {noun}: no strings of lights across the sky, along the ridge or on the ground. Keep the {noun} exactly the same size and shape. Nothing else changes: do not add snow, a wreath, white streaks or anything on the hills.
christmas.keep: The Christmas lights stay switched on: every tiny red, green, gold and blue light keeps glowing just as brightly as before, in the same places, clearly visible through the weather.

new_years.prompt: Add a few small, soft golden fireworks bursting in the sky in the right third, above the {noun}. Keep them small and only in the right third.
